subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We need a verb phrase that completes the sentence to inform what the coded box is known as.
 
• Grammar rules require that a present tense verb concordantly follows a noun subject (in this case, 'The coded box').
 
• Considering that the statement is likely a general or timeless fact (hence, in present tense) about the coded box, the verb phrase 'is called' fits appropriately in context.
 
• 'Is called' denotes that the coded box is referred to or known as a quick response code.

*The coded box placed on the first page of every chapter **is called** quick response code. The first QR code is to (2)_________ the complete e-textbook. The (3)_________ QR codes will help you access the relevant e-resources linked to each other. This will help you(4)_________ your learning in a (5)__________ manner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Will called': This phrase is grammatically incorrect because 'will', a model verb, should be followed by the base form of a verb, not the past participle.
 
• 'Called': This option could possibly work in other contexts but sounds incomplete in this particular sentence.
 
• 'Was called': This would suggest that the coded box was referred to as a quick response code in the past but not necessarily in the present, which is not what the context implies.
